# Vendored Super Productivity plugin API types

Copied from [super-productivity/packages/plugin-api/src](https://github.com/johannesjo/super-productivity/tree/master/packages/plugin-api/src)
(Super Productivity 19.2.0, commit 8183c57). The published npm package `@super-productivity/plugin-api@1.0.1`
predates issue-provider plugins, so the types are kept here instead.
